sections.title: California planting time: regional conditions and frost dates
sections.text: Reviewed summary of UC Master Gardener guidance. Planting guides give approximate windows for cool-season and warm-season crops. Temperature, soil moisture and day length affect success. Consider approximate local first and last frost dates and protect susceptible plants when frost is expected. A statewide planting date cannot represent every California location. Ask for the locality, crop and whether seeds or transplants are being planted; consult a planting guide specific to the region.
